calculus is here, and so is the nspire ٩(>ᴗ<)و

## what's new

- **integrals**: `integral(f,x)` and `integral(f,x,a,b)`, with u-substitution and the work shown
- **limits**: at a number, at ∞ and -∞, and from one side
- **show the work**: tools -> show steps for `solve(`, `d/dx(`, limits and integrals, with a method menu for quadratics
- **TI-Nspire CX / CX II** through Ndless, with its own keys
- absolute value equations, percent, six themes, and a clock for slow answers
- solve, factor, cancel, roots and complex numbers got better, and a pile of wrong answers (`sqrt(x)=-1`, `abs(-3x)`, made up system pairs) got fixed

the whole list is here: https://cloveian.github.io/fluxion/docs/releases/

## install

**TI-84 Plus CE**: send `Fluxion-TI84CE-TIConnectCE.b84` with TI Connect CE (or `Fluxion-TI84CE-TiLP.tig` with TiLP, or unzip `Fluxion-TI84CE-loose-files.zip` and send the files one by one), run `FLUXINST` once, and Fluxion shows up under apps. on OS 5.5 or newer you need [arTIfiCE](https://yvantt.github.io/arTIfiCE/) first, and the [CE C libraries](https://github.com/CE-Programming/libraries/releases) (`clibs.8xg`) have to be on the calculator

**TI-Nspire CX / CX II**: install [Ndless](https://ndless.me) (r2022 on a CX II with OS 6.4.0.74, or r2021 on a CX with OS 4.5.5), send `Fluxion-Nspire.tns` with the TI software or TiLP, and open it from My Documents. `home` quits it

want to see it first? it runs in your browser: https://cloveian.github.io/fluxion/
